scope: Independent provenance and fidelity briefs for five static PIT identity plates: scarface, stone-heart, valkyrie, witch, and enforcer.
rightsNote: Original fan-made OpenAI artwork for this project. Non-official, with no franchise, rights-holder, or 1:1 certification.

stateDefinition.integrated-static-candidate: A producing agent generated the bitmap with built-in OpenAI ImageGen, reported a contact-sheet visual review, and the public V31 manifest records its runtime file and hash. This confirms one fixed fan-made plate only, not official art, exact reconstruction, or animation coverage.
stateDefinition.integrated-proof: A public runtime manifest entry with runtime path and verifiable file hash; file presence alone is insufficient.

sourcePriority: Direct game capture, primary comic panel, or rights-holder material for geometry and asymmetry.
Official publisher, developer, or licensed manufacturer text for identity and explicitly named equipment.
Local project lore for gameplay adaptation only.

localInputs.role: roster IDs and curated source URLs
PIT mechanics, not canonical visual proof

adaptationBoundaries: Scarface: Spear Gun and Maul are licensed, but simultaneous use and exact scar/gear asymmetry are not proven by the reviewed text.
Stone Heart: extended integrated blades and lights are licensed anchors; do not invent a portable loadout or LED colors.
Valkyrie: the official reviewed weapon is a two-handed Norse Hammer; the PIT spear is gameplay adaptation only.
Witch: bone/hide and tracking drone are official anchors; the PIT bow-snare is local adaptation, and the drone should have a separate asset.
Enforcer: never transfer the Bad Blood Predator's arsenal; omit a wrist speargun until primary imagery resolves geometry and side.

publicIntegrationCheck.observedScope: V31 PIT plates: City Hunter and five previously missing fighters
publicIntegrationCheck.note: The public V31 manifest names all five fighters and records runtime paths and hashes. This confirms static runtime integration only; animation coverage remains zero.

acceptanceGates: Use direct primary visuals for anatomy, equipment geometry, and left/right asymmetry before calling any fighter fidelity-accepted.
Require exact opaque #00FF00 background, no green spill or subject green, no floor/shadow/text/logo/UI, and no crop.
Validate alpha extraction, runtime dimensions, hash, pivot, and public manifest entry before marking integrated.
Treat every plate as a fixed pose. A commercial combat set still requires independently authored and reviewed movement, attack, hit, defeat, transition, and effect clips.
warning: This lot records sources, constraints, generation provenance, and static review only. It does not certify rights-holder approval, exact franchise reproduction, runtime integration, gameplay behavior, animation completeness, or commercial-release readiness.
